trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself, awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned. Treat it as your finish line: work the roadmap stages in order, clear the missable warnings early, and leave the long counters for the final cleanup stage.
steps: Earn every other trophy on this list
Use the Planner stage bars to find unfinished stages
Finish the 100 percent and counter trophies last

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the start of the story. It introduces the protagonists and the basics of moving, driving and following mission markers, so simply finish it to the mission complete screen.
steps: Start a new game and begin Gone Fishing
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission
Reach the mission complete screen

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission that belongs to Chapter 1. Story chapters cannot be skipped, so keep following the main markers and this unlocks as the chapter closes.
steps: Follow the main story markers
Complete each Chapter 1 mission in order
Finish the chapter finale

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all of the story missions in Chapter 2. The chapter opens after Chapter 1 ends, and the trophy pops when its final mission is done, so no side work is required beyond the main thread.
steps: Finish Chapter 1 first
Play each Chapter 2 mission in order
Complete the chapter finale

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3 of the main story from start to finish. Keep an eye out for the partner and robbery trophies listed in this stage while the chapter missions are available, then close out the chapter.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 first
Play each Chapter 3 mission in order
Complete the chapter finale

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the story missions of Chapter 4. By this point the map and activity list are wide open, but the trophy only needs the chapter itself finished, so prioritise the main markers if you are pushing for the ending.
steps: Finish Chapter 3 first
Play each Chapter 4 mission in order
Complete the chapter finale

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission of the game. It only becomes available after the earlier chapters are complete, and the gold trophy is awarded when the finale ends, whatever choices the run involved.
steps: Complete all chapters before the finale
Start the final mission from the story marker
Play it through to the ending

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. It is a main-thread mission rather than an optional one, so following the story will bring you to it naturally.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run marker in the story
Complete the mission objectives in order
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, the named heist mission in the story. Prepare before starting it: arrive with armour, snacks and a reliable vehicle, because heist missions chain several combat and escape phases together.
steps: Unlock The Cartel Heist in the story
Stock armour and health items before starting
Complete the heist and its escape phase

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it becomes available. As with the other named missions it sits on the main thread, so progress the story until its marker appears and play it through.
steps: Progress the story until Child's Play appears
Go to its marker and start it
Complete the mission

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Headliners during the story. Follow its marker when it unlocks, complete each objective the mission gives you, and the trophy lands at the mission complete screen.
steps: Unlock Headliners in the story
Start it from its map marker
Complete all of its objectives

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. While you are at VCIA for this mission, remember the separate Catch Me If You Can trophy is tied to an unscheduled departure there, so look for that opportunity before the mission window closes.
steps: Unlock VCIA Takedown in the story
Complete the takedown objectives
Watch for the unscheduled departure chance at VCIA

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory when the story offers it. Go in prepared with armour and a strong loadout, work through its objectives in order, and the trophy follows the mission complete screen.
steps: Unlock Operation Savage Glory in the story
Prepare armour and weapons beforehand
Complete the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach a full 100 percent on the in-game completion counter. That means the story plus the activities, collectibles and exploration tracked elsewhere on this list, so use the Collectibles counters and stage bars here to find whatever percentage is still missing at the end.
steps: Finish the story and the final mission
Clear every activity and collectible counter in this guide
Check the in-game completion percentage and mop up the remainder

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total, tracked with the counter in the Collectibles view. Stunts are repeatable, so build a routine: whenever you drive between missions, take ramps and jumps you pass instead of saving them all for one long grind at the end.
steps: Learn what the game registers as a completed stunt
Hit ramps and jumps during normal travel
Use the counter here until it reaches 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every distinct type of activity at least once. Do this early: sampling each activity in Stage 1 teaches you which ones you enjoy and which ones feed other trophies, such as races, fishing and the shooting range.
steps: Open the map and note each activity type
Play one session of each type
Tick off types as you try them so none is missed

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge, not just a single clear. Practise one weapon category at a time, learn each challenge layout, and replay immediately while the target pattern is fresh rather than moving on after a silver.
steps: Unlock all Shooting Range challenges
Gold one weapon category at a time
Replay near-misses straight away until every challenge is gold

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations; a participation finish is not enough. Run a location once to learn the gate order, then run it again for the win, and keep a note of which locations are already won.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location
Scout the course with a practice run
Win at each location once

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeating one easy race does not build the total. Spread your wins across the race list, use the counter in this guide to track distinct wins, and bring a suitable vehicle class for each event.
steps: Enter races across different locations and classes
Win each distinct race once
Track distinct wins with the counter until 20

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Enter a fishing challenge against Cal and finish ahead of him. Learn the fishing controls in a free session first, then take the challenge once you can land catches reliably instead of losing fish on the reel-in.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal
Practise landing fish in a free session
Enter Cal's fishing challenge and beat his score

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to completion. Any arcade cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game you find, finish a full run rather than quitting mid-game, and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the world
Start a game and play a full run
Finish the game instead of quitting early

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until you finish his final mission. Stranger strands unlock in steps, so complete each Andy job as it appears instead of leaving the strand half done while the story moves on.
steps: Meet Andy and start his strand
Complete each Andy mission as it unlocks
Finish Andy's final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. Keep returning to Kenton's marker whenever a new job in the strand appears, since the finale only unlocks after the earlier jobs are done.
steps: Meet Kenton and start his strand
Complete each Kenton mission as it unlocks
Finish Kenton's final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's jobs build on each other in order, so clear them as they surface and the last one awards the trophy when it ends.
steps: Meet Billy and start his strand
Complete each Billy mission as it unlocks
Finish Billy's final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Fully complete eight different stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida; starting a strand is not enough, its final mission must be done. Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy and Tyrone on this list are five of them, so finishing those strands leaves only three more to find.
steps: Finish the named stranger strands in Stage 3
Seek out further stranger markers across Leonida
Use the counter until 8 strands are fully complete

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand to its final mission and complete it. Randy's jobs count toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so finishing his strand pays off twice.
steps: Meet Randy and start his strand
Complete each Randy mission as it unlocks
Finish Randy's final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. As with the other strangers, the finale stays locked until the earlier jobs in the strand are cleared, so work them in order.
steps: Meet Tyrone and start his strand
Complete each Tyrone mission as it unlocks
Finish Tyrone's final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. These spots are spread across the whole state, so pair the hunt with the exploration trophy The Goodtime State and sweep one region at a time instead of crossing the map repeatedly.
steps: Note meditation spots region by region
Travel to each spot and complete the meditation
Sweep any missed region before finishing exploration

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's request, track the unique animal he names, and complete the hunt for him. Prepare a suitable weapon and vehicle before setting out, and follow the hunt steps the game gives you rather than chasing the animal on sight.
steps: Accept the hunt from Bret
Prepare and travel to the hunting area
Track and take down the unique animal for Bret

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card needed to finish three full collectible card sets; scattered single cards do not count until a set closes. Focus on one set at a time, sweep its locations in a single route, and use the counter here to record each completed set.
steps: Choose one card set and collect its full run
Repeat for a second and third set
Use the counter until 3 sets are complete

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. Because locations must be distinct, work region by region and log progress with the counter here, doing a handful whenever you arrive somewhere new instead of leaving all 100 for the end.
steps: Learn the WAiNK It action at your first location
Use it at new locations as you travel each region
Track the total with the counter until 100

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges offered by the game. Challenges vary in type, so pick the short repeatable ones that suit your play style, and add progress to the counter here each session so the total never becomes a mystery.
steps: Browse the available challenge list
Complete short challenges in batches
Track completions with the counter until 50

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While travelling with your partner, raise your wanted level to four stars and then lose it completely and escape. Stay together for the whole attempt: build the heat with your partner present, then break line of sight, swap vehicles if needed, and wait out the search until the stars clear.
steps: Travel with your partner in the same vehicle
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars together
Break pursuit and stay hidden until the heat clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in one unbroken run while keeping a wanted level the whole time; losing the heat resets the chain. Plan a tight route of three nearby shops beforehand, keep moving between them, and only shake the police after the third robbery registers.
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route
Rob the first shop with your partner and gain a wanted level
Rob shops two and three without losing the heat

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles, which means encountering new models rather than reusing your favourites. Make a habit of jumping into unfamiliar cars you see parked or in traffic, and log the running total with the counter here as new models become rarer.
steps: Enter unfamiliar vehicles whenever you spot one
Visit different districts for different traffic pools
Track discoveries with the counter until 100

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus; spreading the kills across two uses does not count. Wait for a grouped fight, line up several targets before triggering it, and use a weapon with a large magazine so you never stop to reload mid-run.
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies grouped up
Charge Combat Focus and equip a high-capacity weapon
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to VCIA, the airport location of the VCIA Takedown mission: if that story window passes without the departure, a normal playthrough may not offer the same chance again.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, leave in a way the airport did not schedule: take an aircraft or vehicle and depart without following the normal route out. Do it while the VCIA Takedown story brings you there, because that visit is the reliable window for it.
steps: Reach VCIA during the VCIA Takedown part of the story
Find an aircraft or vehicle you can depart in
Leave VCIA unscheduled instead of exiting normally

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at Rhinos, the game's tanks, and the heat around them. Seek out a Rhino once military hardware starts appearing, get involved with it as the description hints, and survive the encounter; keep a save beforehand so a failed attempt costs nothing.
steps: Progress until Rhinos can be encountered
Make a save before engaging
Get into the Rhino encounter the description describes

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away with nobody detecting you. Scout the store first, approach quietly, avoid cameras and witnesses, and leave by a back route; if you are spotted, let the attempt go and try again cleanly rather than forcing it.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and scout its entrances
Enter quietly and avoid detection while robbing it
Leave unseen with the take

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully rob five bank vaults, escaping after each one; a vault where you are caught does not add to the total. Treat each vault as a mini-heist: plan the exit vehicle before you go in, and record each clean escape with the counter here.
steps: Locate a bank vault and plan your escape route
Rob the vault and escape cleanly
Repeat and track escapes with the counter until 5

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck in free roam, rob it, and escape the response. Bring a vehicle fast enough to leave in and enough firepower to open the truck up, then break away and lose the heat to finish the job.
steps: Spot an armored truck in free roam
Stop it and take its cargo
Escape and lose the heat

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida so the whole state counts as explored. Work the map in a grid, region by region, and combine the sweep with meditation spots, card hunting and WAiNK locations so one long tour feeds several trophies at once.
steps: Divide the map into regions and sweep one at a time
Enter every named area as you pass through
Revisit any greyed-out pockets at the end

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation owned by each gang; robbing the same gang twice does not advance it. Keep a written note of which gangs you have already hit, since the game expects one operation per gang across the whole set.
steps: Identify each gang's illegal operations
Rob one operation per gang
Note each gang cleared so none is repeated or missed

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: The name signals the very start of the game: the Ocean Beach cocktail moment belongs to the opening, so skipping past that scene can lock it for the rest of the playthrough.
trophies.guide: Early on, take the moment on Ocean Beach to enjoy a cocktail with a view instead of rushing the next objective. The trophy name marks it as a beginning-of-game beat, so slow down when the story first brings you to Ocean Beach and interact with the cocktail prompt.
steps: Reach Ocean Beach near the start of the story
Find the cocktail interaction with the view
Take the drink before moving the story on

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Driving out through a showroom window is a one-scene set piece: once the showroom visit in the story is over, the staged chance to do it in classic style is gone.
trophies.guide: When the story puts you inside a vehicle showroom, get in a car and drive straight out through the showroom glass instead of using the door. It is a set-piece moment, so take the chance while that scene is live rather than expecting a repeatable prompt later.
steps: Reach the vehicle showroom scene in the story
Get into a showroom car
Drive out through the window in classic style

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through the description asks for there. Head to the alley in free roam, start the bowling activity, and play it through properly instead of quitting after a single throw.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start the bowling activity
Play through with a proper follow-through

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This cryptic description celebrates the two protagonists' partnership and its public appeal. Keep the partners together for shared activities, complete partner jobs as they appear, and the moment the description refers to will register as their partnership reaches its widest audience.
steps: Keep both partners together for shared activities
Complete partner missions as they appear
Watch for the partnership moment the description hints at

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices are made once as the story passes them: a choice point you play through cannot be re-decided later in the same run, so the total depends on decisions taken along the way.
trophies.guide: The game quietly tracks the choices you make, for better or worse, and this trophy rewards making them as you play. Do not reload to undo decisions while chasing it: play the story decisively, take optional interactions when offered, and let your choices accumulate across the whole run.
steps: Play the story without reloading past decisions
Take optional choice interactions when offered
Keep making choices until the tracker completes

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: It needs a failed first attempt followed by success: succeeding first time at a one-off attempt can leave nothing to retry in that playthrough.
trophies.guide: Fail at something once, then succeed at the same thing on your second try; the description's joke only lands if the first attempt went wrong. If an attempt is going badly, let it fail instead of reloading, then complete it on the retry so both halves of the sequence register.
steps: Start an attempt you can retry
Let a first attempt fail rather than reloading
Succeed on the second try

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of the strange unexplained events hidden in Leonida. These oddities reward exploration away from the main roads, so investigate unusual sights and sounds you notice while sweeping the state for The Goodtime State, and stay to watch the event play out.
steps: Explore off the main routes while travelling Leonida
Investigate anything strange you spot or hear
Stay and witness the event to its end

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack out of the window, bowling style. Drive slowly past a target on foot, swing the melee drive-by as you pass, and repeat with a fresh target if the first swing only clips them.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon ready
Drive slowly past a pedestrian
Land the melee drive-by so they are bowled over

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the laundered total reaches 250,000 dollars; normal earnings do not count, only bills passed through the laundering route. Make it a habit after robberies and heists, and log the laundered amount with the counter here in round thousands.
steps: Unlock laundering through your contacts
Send marked bills to be laundered after jobs
Track the laundered total with the counter until 250000

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a combined 100,000 dollars in shops across the game; the total is cumulative, so money spent on clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all feeds it. Buy what your platinum run needs anyway, and add spending to the counter here in round thousands so the grind never needs a separate session.
steps: Spend at shops as you gear up through the story
Include big purchases like weapons and vehicle work
Track total spend with the counter until 100000

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on sale in Leonida. Garages unlock as the story and your funds grow, so save this for the cleanup stage when the heist money is in, then tour the remaining for-sale garages and buy each one outright.
steps: Progress until garage properties are on sale
Build funds through heists and laundering
Buy every remaining garage property

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app to register ten vehicles. Register each new vehicle you intend to keep as soon as you get it rather than batching them later, and use the counter here until the app holds ten registrations.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app with a vehicle you keep
Register the vehicle in the app
Repeat and track registrations with the counter until 10
